chunks.title: Khidmat Markaz App & WhatsApp Support
chunks.content: For unresolved complaints, advanced technical issues, booking a technician, claiming a warranty, or registering a product, customers should be directed to use the PEL Khidmat Markaz App (which provides GPS tracking of technicians). Alternatively, customers can contact official PEL WhatsApp Support at 03001102103 or call the 24-hour PEL CARE hotline at (042) 111-102-103.
